_comment: License policy of the guardrails, spec section 4 (Plan 10, Global Constraints and ruling P4). SPDX ids are compared case-insensitively; a trailing * matches any suffix. allowedFor lists licenses allowed only for the packages whose id matches one of its patterns: OFL-1.1 for font packages only (user decision 2026-11-14, guardrails sections 4 and 6, #11, #102, #154). PostgreSQL (the PostgreSQL License, Npgsql) is allowed since 2026-11-19 (#279, plan 2.7a ruling P13). A license that is neither allowed nor forbidden needs review. packageOverrides correct the copyright or project URL that one exact package version states, with the source of the correction.

deniedPackages.reason: FluentAssertions 8.x is commercial (spec section 4); stay on 6.x.

packageOverrides.source: LICENSE inside the npm package and site/assets/fonts/OFL-Sora.txt; package.json author is the fontsource packager (Google Inc.), checked 2026-11-14.

The nuspec has no <copyright> (its authors are 'System.Activities') and no license file; copyright from the LICENSE of https://github.com/UiPath/CoreWF (develop, master and main branches), checked 2026-11-12.
